# Integer

Gives you one whole number to share between connected settings.

`lfs.integer` · Input

## How to use

Connect Value to counts or whole-number settings.\
Start at 0 and use the step buttons to change by one.

## Inputs

| Name | Identifier | Type | Default | Range / choices | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| Value | `Value` | lfs.int | 0 | step 1 | Shared whole number. 0 is the default; negative and positive numbers are allowed. |

## Outputs

| Name | Identifier | Type | Default | Range / choices | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| Value | `Value` | lfs.int | — | — | Resulting number, in the units of your calculation. Connect it to a compatible numeric input. |
